name: print-social-hitech-minimal-tech-posts-pink-purple-circuit-lines
title: 'HITECH Minimal Tech' Instagram pack in deep purple with pink neon circuit-line borders and worker figures
whatItIs: Five deep-purple square posts framed by thin pink and cyan neon circuit-line borders with dot nodes, bold split-colour 'HITECH' headlines, small white line-art figures of workers with laptops and gears, and 'Minimal Tech' subtitles with a website line.
whatItMeans: Sharp and techy; glowing circuit borders on deep purple make a generic tech template feel like a specialised electronics brand.
techniques: Frame a post with thin neon circuit-line borders.
Split a headline word across two accent colours.
Add small line-art worker figures for a human touch on a tech theme.

vocabulary.definition: A decorative frame styled after electronic pathways.
A single word coloured in two different hues.
